nodes.title: Export all database data as a .json file
nodes.summary: The Export button on the systems list page currently downloads the compiled database data as a .zip file. Change it to compile all systems and projects from the database into one JSON structure, reusing the existing export data builder, and download that structure directly as a .json file. Update the button handler and the success message to match. Keep the import able to read the exported .json file as well as existing .zip exports, so exported data can still be restored.

nodes.title: Confirm the project stays deploy-ready after the change
nodes.summary: The repository already has a root Dockerfile and a Vite preview server bound to 0.0.0.0 on port 8000. It runs as the non-root node user and does not use privileged mode, the Docker socket or extra capabilities. After the export change, check that the image still builds from the repository root and still serves on port 8000, and that the README still describes this accurately. Also confirm the repository is hosted on github.com, gitlab.com or bitbucket.org and is reachable over https with no credentials in the URL. Nothing else changes.
